----------------------------------------------------------------
-- PlayroomToy_IconUI.lua
-- Attach to the ICON UI entity (must have EntityUI)
--
-- Reads:
--   SHARED.PLAYROOM_TOY_ICON_SHOW[TOY_ID] = true/false
----------------------------------------------------------------

local DEBUG = false

-- Set this to the toy/trigger id (the same id InteractionBox reports)
local TOY_ID = 0

local IN_TABLE = "PLAYROOM_TOY_ICON_SHOW"

local function set_visible(v)
    if EntityUI == nil then
        print("[PlayroomToy_IconUI] ERROR: EntityUI nil on icon EntityID " .. tostring(EntityID))
        return
    end
    EntityUI:SetVisible(v)
end

local function should_show()
    if SHARED == nil then return false end
    local t = SHARED[IN_TABLE]
    if t == nil then return false end
    return t[TOY_ID] == true
end

function on_create(self)
    SHARED = SHARED or {}
    SHARED[IN_TABLE] = SHARED[IN_TABLE] or {}

    set_visible(false)

    if DEBUG then
        print("[PlayroomToy_IconUI] create icon=", EntityID, " toy=", TOY_ID)
    end
end

function on_update(self, dt)
    if TOY_ID == 0 then
        set_visible(false)
        return
    end

    set_visible(should_show())
end
